# Agent skill fixtures

The [skill test](../../skill.rs) resolves the assets named in the examples of the
[agent skill](../../../skills/mote/SKILL.md) from this directory: `photo.png`, a
96 by 64 pixel image; the data files `sales.json` and `sales.csv`; and
`fonts/SourceSerif4-Regular.ttf`, a face of Source Serif 4 distributed under the
SIL Open Font License, whose text accompanies it.
